# `layout.carrier.add`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/layout.carrier.add.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`layout.carrier.add` (`AddCarrier`, D6): adds a rail or a duct to a mounting surface.

The path is in the surface frame (`u` right, `v` up) and axis-parallel (D5): a rail two points on one horizontal or
vertical line, a duct an orthogonal polyline. A rail's profile comes from its part's rail section when it has one
(a different `profile` is refused). Rejected: a surface or part copy that does not exist (`/surface`, `/part`);
parameters of the other kind (`/params`); a profile that is not a rail profile, a duct length ≤ 0 (`/params/…`); a
path of the wrong number of points, a segment without length or at another angle (`/path`). Interactive. Outcome:
the new carrier.

## Types

### CarrierKindParam

The kind of a new carrier (D3).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"rail"` | A mounting (DIN) rail. |
| `"duct"` | A wiring duct. |

### CarrierParamsParam

A carrier's parameters (D3, doc 12 §2.4), tagged by its kind as stored: `{"rail": {"profile": …}}` or
`{"duct": {"width": …, "height": …}}`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A rail.

   Shape: object { `rail`: object { `profile`: [`MountKind`](#mountkind) } }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `rail` | object { `profile`: [`MountKind`](#mountkind) } | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: A duct.

   Shape: object { `duct`: object { `cover?`: boolean or `null`, `height`: [`CmdNm`](#cmdnm), `slot_pitch?`: [`CmdNm`](#cmdnm) or `null`, `width`: [`CmdNm`](#cmdnm) } }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `duct` | object { `cover?`: boolean or `null`, `height`: [`CmdNm`](#cmdnm), `slot_pitch?`: [`CmdNm`](#cmdnm) or `null`, `width`: [`CmdNm`](#cmdnm) } | yes |  |  |

### CmdNm

A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)

### CmdSurfacePt2

A point [u, v] in a mounting surface's frame in nanometres, u to the right and v upwards (doc 12 §2.1).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### MountKind

How a part mounts (doc 12 §2.5); also the profile of a rail section.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"ts35x7_5"` | Top-hat rail 35 × 7.5 mm. |
| `"ts35x15"` | Top-hat rail 35 × 15 mm. |
| `"ts32"` | G rail 32 mm. |
| `"ts15"` | Miniature top-hat rail 15 mm. |
| `"screw"` | Screwed to the mounting surface. |
| `"busbar_adapter"` | On a busbar adapter. |
| `"door_cutout"` | In a door cut-out. |
| `"on_parent"` | On its parent device. |
| `"none"` | Not mounted. |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
